linkedIn.headline: Author of 5 #1 NYT/WSJ bestsellers, early-stage investor, Tim Ferriss Show podcast (1B+ downloads), founder of the Saisei Foundation
linkedIn.about:
Tim Ferriss has been listed as one of Fast Company’s “Most Innovative Business People.” He is an angel investor/advisor (Facebook, Twitter, Uber, Nextdoor, Alibaba, etc.) and author of five #1 NYT/WSJ bestsellers, including The 4-Hour Workweek. Find his current antics at www.tim.blog.

2007 - Present -
Host of The Tim Ferriss Show podcast, the first business-interview podcast to pass 100M downloads and selected for "Best of iTunes" three years running. Author of five #1 NYT/WSJ bestsellers: The 4-Hour Workweek, The 4-Hour Body, The 4-Hour Chef, Tools of Titans, and Tribe of Mentors. Latest experiments and writing at http://www.tim.blog

2003 - Present - 
Guest Lecturer at Princeton University, High-tech Entrepreneurship (Electrical Engineering)

2001 - Jan. 2009 -
Co-founder and Senior Director of BrainQUICKEN LLC, neurological and sports nutrition development firm with distribution in 15+ countries.  Sold to private equity firm.

Specialties: Business: Consumer product design and marketing, social entrepreneurship and metrics (conversation, cost-per-acquisition, etc.), multivariate testing, infrastructure and manufacturing.
